note: No news feed on the desk. Links out to where news is published, plus two short briefs written by Claude from checked sources: brief = the last session(s) and what to look for today and tomorrow; week = what has happened this week (on a weekend: the week just gone) and what is ahead. Refreshed daily by the "desk-news-brief" scheduled task (scripts/news-brief.md); facts only, never a call.

summary: Weekend after a shortened US session on Fri 27 Nov: S&P 500 closed at 7,297 (+1.6%), still below its 200-day average (7,354); Nasdaq Composite +2.3%; VIX 23.8 (-3.0pt). All 11 S&P 500 sectors rose, led by AI and chip names.
Single names Friday: Sandisk was the top S&P 500 gainer (about +16%); Anthropic +11% to $91.88, above its $83 IPO price; Nvidia +0.8%.
Friday close: US 10-year yield 4.94% (+9bp), dollar index 104.01 (+0.3%), gold +2.9% to 3,640, WTI 83.08 (-0.7%). Bitcoin, trading over the weekend, at 59,686 (-0.3%).
FX on Friday: AUD firmest of the eight (+0.3% against the other seven), CHF weakest (-0.3%), NZD -0.2%; AUDJPY +0.2% to 105.70.
watch: Sun 29 Nov: Spanish general election (polls close 20:00 CET), Swiss referendums and an OPEC+ ministerial meeting.
Mon 30 Nov: China November NBS PMIs, Japan October industrial production, Swiss Q3 GDP, German November CPI, Canada Q3 GDP.
Nvidia GTC Washington DC runs Mon 30 Nov to Thu 3 Dec.

happened: Week of 23 Nov: S&P 500 +5.6% to 7,297, its best week since April 2025; Nasdaq Composite +6.7%; VIX -12.1pt to 23.8. Monday's rally was the biggest since April 2025; US markets were shut Thursday for Thanksgiving.
Nvidia: Jensen Huang's sudden resignation as CEO was followed by his surprise reinstatement (AP). Anthropic ended the week at $91.88, below its first-day high of $115.
Data: the US PCE update showed inflation worsened in October (AP); Tokyo November core CPI 2.9%, headline 2.8%; Bank of Korea raised its rate to 3.25%.
US 10-year yield 4.94% (+2bp on the week), dollar index 104.01 (+0.2%), gold +3.5% to 3,640, WTI -1.1% to 83.08, Bitcoin -2.4% to 59,686.
FX on the week: CHF strongest (+1.1% against the other seven), CAD next (+0.5%), AUD weakest (-0.6%); AUDJPY -0.6%.
ahead: Mon 30 Nov: Swiss Q3 GDP, German November CPI, Canada Q3 GDP, Japan October industrial production. Tue 1 Dec: final manufacturing PMIs, euro area November flash CPI (October 4.0%), US ISM manufacturing and October JOLTS.

Wed 2 Dec: Australia Q3 GDP, Swiss November CPI (October 1.5% y/y), euro area October unemployment, US ADP. Thu 3 Dec: final services PMIs, US ISM services; Newsquawk lists Jensen Huang's Senate Banking Committee testimony for Thursday.
Fri 4 Dec: US November payrolls (consensus +90K, unemployment 4.1%, per Newsquawk), Canada November jobs report, US UMich preliminary December survey, euro area October retail sales.

Central banks: no decision for the eight majors this week. Next: RBA 8 Dec (cash rate 4.85% after a November hike), BoC 9 Dec (BoC schedule), Fed 9 Dec, BoJ 18 Dec (per Newsquawk). ECB, BoE, SNB and RBNZ dates not confirmed today. Exact release times: Market Context calendar.
